d:
Takshashila ke maharaj aanbhi naresh ke aatmahatya ke bad unke putr ambhikumar takshashila ke har nirnay ke lie svatantr ho jata hai, aachary vishnugupt ke samjhane ke bad bhi ambhikumar alakshendr se sandhi banana chahta hai, isi se asantusht ho aachary vishnugupt kekaiy se madad ki apeksha le vahan jate hai
Aage kya hota hai - dekhie is bhag men.
